description: Quinoline alkaloid with dual UV absorption bands at ~250 nm (pi-pi*, epsilon ~30 000) and ~350 nm (n-pi*, epsilon ~5 700) in 0.05 M H2SO4, where the molecule exists as a dication and emits intense blue fluorescence at ~450 nm.
transition: pi to pi* (250 nm) and n to pi* (350 nm) electronic transitions
clinicalNote: Quinine sulfate in 0.05 M H2SO4 is the NIST/IUPAC primary fluorescence quantum yield standard (Phi = 0.546) and was the first antimalarial drug; monitored by UV-Vis in pharmaceutical quality control.

sources.citation: Weast, R.C. (ed.). Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 57th ed. CRC Press, 1976, p. C-481. [via PubChem HSDB record 2501]
